end.summary:
• Sorted wet and dry waste using examples such as peels, rice, paper, bottles, and packets.
• Explained that peels and leaves rot in a compost pit, while plastic does not.
• Suggested keeping desks and floors clean and putting wrappers in bins.
• Discussed shade from trees, reporting dripping taps, and collecting roof water in a tank.
• Teach-back was not completed; the effect of a dripping tap remained unclear.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste, explaining composting, saving water, and keeping school spaces clean, green, and safe. They corrected the mix-up about plastic in compost after revisiting it, and suggested reporting a tap that will not stop and collecting rainwater in a tank. The estimate that a dripping tap wastes only a few drops was not corrected later; at home, try watching a dripping tap for one minute and collect the water to discuss why leaks matter.
